From 0b10f64dbe60cb1b2056f647c052b4278627fe24 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vivek Gautam <vivek.gautam@codeaurora.org>
Date: Fri, 27 Jan 2017 13:40:19 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] phy: qcom-ufs: Fix misplaced jump label

We want to skip only tx/rx_iface clocks and not ref_clk_src
as well. Fix the jump label accordingly.

Fixes: 300f96771d78 ("phy: qcom-ufs: Skip obtaining rx/tx_iface_clk for msm8996 based phy")

Cc: Subhash Jadavani <subhashj@codeaurora.org>
Cc: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>
Cc: Kishon Vijay Abraham I <kishon@ti.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Vivek Gautam <vivek.gautam@codeaurora.org>
Signed-off-by: Kishon Vijay Abraham I <kishon@ti.com>

diff --git a/drivers/phy/phy-qcom-ufs.c b/drivers/phy/phy-qcom-ufs.c
index c145fa6e824c..43865ef340e2 100644
--- a/drivers/phy/phy-qcom-ufs.c
+++ b/drivers/phy/phy-qcom-ufs.c
@@ -189,12 +189,12 @@ int ufs_qcom_phy_init_clks(struct ufs_qcom_phy *phy_common)
 	if (err)
 		goto out;
 
+skip_txrx_clk:
 	err = ufs_qcom_phy_clk_get(phy_common->dev, "ref_clk_src",
 				   &phy_common->ref_clk_src);
 	if (err)
 		goto out;
 
-skip_txrx_clk:
 	/*
 	 * "ref_clk_parent" is optional hence don't abort init if it's not
 	 * found.
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/phy/phy-qcom-ufs.c`**
- The label `skip_txrx_clk` was moved to a new position in the code. 
- The original label was located before the call to `ufs_qcom_phy_clk_get` for `ref_clk_src`, and it has been repositioned to be after the error check for obtaining the `tx/rx_iface` clocks.
- This change ensures that the code correctly skips only the `tx/rx_iface` clocks while still attempting to obtain the `ref_clk_src`.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit (300f96771d78) that incorrectly skipped obtaining the `ref_clk_src` clock along with the `tx/rx_iface` clocks. 
- By fixing the jump label's position, the patch ensures that the `ref_clk_src` is still obtained even when the `tx/rx_iface` clocks are skipped, thus restoring the intended functionality of the code.

Here is the commit message:
phy: qcom-ufs: Fix misplaced jump label

We want to skip only tx/rx_iface clocks and not ref_clk_src
as well. Fix the jump label accordingly.

Fixes: 300f96771d78 ("phy: qcom-ufs: Skip obtaining rx/tx_iface_clk for msm8996 based phy")

Cc: Subhash Jadavani <subhashj@codeaurora.org>
Cc: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>
Cc: Kishon Vijay Abraham I <kishon@ti.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Vivek Gautam <vivek.gautam@codeaurora.org>
Signed-off-by: Kishon Vijay Abraham I <kishon@ti.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect placement of the jump label `skip_txrx_clk`, which led to the `ref_clk_src` clock being skipped when it should have been obtained. This was a result of the code logic that intended to skip only the `tx/rx_iface` clocks but inadvertently affected the `ref_clk_src` due to the misplaced label.

Here is the patch:
 
 int ufs_qcom_phy_init_clks(struct ufs_qcom_phy *phy_common)
 {
 	int err;
 
 	if (of_device_is_compatible(phy_common->dev->of_node,
 				"qcom,msm8996-ufs-phy-qmp-14nm"))
 		goto skip_txrx_clk;
 
 	err = ufs_qcom_phy_clk_get(phy_common->dev, "tx_iface_clk",
 				   &phy_common->tx_iface_clk);
 	if (err)
 		goto out;
 
 	err = ufs_qcom_phy_clk_get(phy_common->dev, "rx_iface_clk",
 				   &phy_common->rx_iface_clk);
 	if (err)
 		goto out;
 
+skip_txrx_clk:
 	err = ufs_qcom_phy_clk_get(phy_common->dev, "ref_clk_src",
 				   &phy_common->ref_clk_src);
 	if (err)
 		goto out;
 
-skip_txrx_clk:
 	/*
 	 * "ref_clk_parent" is optional hence don't abort init if it's not
 	 * found.
 	 */
 	__ufs_qcom_phy_clk_get(phy_common->dev, "ref_clk_parent",
 				   &phy_common->ref_clk_parent, false);
 
 	err = ufs_qcom_phy_clk_get(phy_common->dev, "ref_clk",
 				   &phy_common->ref_clk);
 
 out:
 	return err;
 }
 EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(ufs_qcom_phy_init_clks);
